I work out what's actually possible for a customer, what's actually feasible, and
then build the small proof of concept that shows them it works. That has taken me
into a fairly awkward set of environments: Kubernetes deployed onto a submarine,
air-gapped because there is no bandwidth underwater; a border control platform
supported from a secure room during the rollout of a 4,000-node cluster; gene
therapy pipelines demoed straight back to the customer.

Lately that work is machine learning — a multi-agent platform for drug discovery,
and fine-tuning Google's MedGemma to write radiology reports from breast scans it
had never seen.

SC cleared. 12 AWS certifications. Based in London.
